system.description:
Use this skill just after the target makes an [Attack Check] for an attack with [Target: Area] that includes the square you are in. Change the target's attack to [Target: Single] with you as the target. 

(Hate Top): You may use this skill against attacks with [Target: Wide, Line] as well.

A special skill that allows you to protect your allies from behind by standing in front of the enemy. You can stop even attacks that involve those around you by yourself.
